research_mode: official Home Office accredited statistics; fail-closed limitations; no parcel score, candidate value or business result

sources.name: Self-defined British nationality
verified_claims: Where nationality was known, 1,870 of 1,949 linked arrests, or 96%, were self-defined British or British dual nationality.
limitations: Self-defined nationality does not indicate origin, conduct or parcel risk.

sources.name: Nationality interpretation
verified_claims: The release notes that nationality is declared at arrest and may differ from country of origin.
limitations: Nationality categories must not be treated as ethnicity, residence or location risk.

sources.name: Non-linked annual comparison
verified_claims: The 242 non-linked arrests represented a 2% increase from 238 in the previous year.
limitations: A small national change is not evidence of a local trend.

sources.name: Non-linked charged
verified_claims: Of the 242 non-linked arrests, 67 were charged.
limitations: Charge counts are provisional case outcomes and not parcel indicators.

sources.name: Non-linked released without charge
verified_claims: Of the 242 non-linked arrests, 52 were released without charge.
limitations: Release without charge illustrates why arrests must not be equated with guilt.

sources.name: Non-linked alternative action
verified_claims: Six of the 242 non-linked arrests had alternative action.
limitations: Alternative action combines several possible resolutions and cannot support local scoring.

sources.name: Non-linked decision pending
verified_claims: Seven of the 242 non-linked arrests had a decision pending.
limitations: Pending cases are incomplete and should not be treated as final outcomes.

sources.name: Non-linked bail or investigation
verified_claims: One hundred and ten of the 242 non-linked arrests were bailed to return or released under investigation.
limitations: These cases were unresolved at the data cutoff.

sources.name: Non-linked terrorism-related charges
verified_claims: Of the 67 charged individuals, 52 were charged under terrorism-related legislation.
limitations: Charge classification does not establish conviction or parcel risk.

sources.name: Section 5 charges
verified_claims: Twelve individuals were charged under section 5 of the Terrorism Act 2006 for preparation of terrorist acts.
limitations: The count is national and cannot be attributed to a neighbourhood.

sources.name: Section 58 charges
verified_claims: Eleven individuals were charged under section 58 of the Terrorism Act 2000 for collection of information useful to terrorism.
limitations: Charges are allegations and not parcel-level evidence.

sources.name: Non-linked prosecutions and convictions
verified_claims: Nine individuals charged with terrorism-related offences were prosecuted and all nine were convicted.
limitations: This subset is based on progressed cases and is not representative of all arrests.

sources.name: Section 41 arrests
verified_claims: Forty of the 3,061 arrests, or 1%, were made under section 41 of the Terrorism Act 2000.
limitations: The statistic describes arresting legislation, not local incidence.

sources.name: Arrests under other legislation
verified_claims: The remaining 3,021 arrests, or 99%, were made under other legislation, including PACE.
limitations: The category includes non-terrorism legislation and requires careful interpretation.

sources.name: Delayed solicitor requests
verified_claims: From January to March 2026, there were 14 instances where a request for access to a solicitor was delayed.
limitations: This procedural count is not a parcel-level safety measure.

sources.name: Terrorism-related charge classification
verified_claims: Of 551 total charges, 536 were for terrorism-related offences.
limitations: The classification can include charges under non-terrorism legislation considered terrorism-related.

sources.name: All arrests by recorded sex
verified_claims: Among 3,055 arrests where sex was known, 1,467 were female and 1,587 male.
limitations: Recorded-sex aggregates must not be used for individual or location profiling.

sources.name: Non-linked arrests by recorded sex
verified_claims: Among 241 non-linked arrests where sex was known, 219 were male and 22 female.
limitations: Demographic composition is descriptive and not a local risk indicator.

sources.name: All arrests age 30 and above
verified_claims: Persons aged 30 and above accounted for 2,671 arrests, or 87%, where age was known.
limitations: Age-group proportions cannot support parcel-level inference.

sources.name: Court data date basis
verified_claims: Court proceedings data are based on trial completion date and are not directly comparable with arrest-outcome data based on arrest date.
limitations: Different time bases must not be combined as if they were one cohort.
